security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop window and tray for mihomo-server
bundle.longDescription: Opens the local mihomo-server management page in a window and controls proxy mode, TUN, nodes and the core from the system tray. Installs mihomo-server when it is missing.
